tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dza pa ra mārtha sarba karmo da ya utta ra tant+ra rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i byed pa po/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug mas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das ma/ sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgyan pa ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ma/ ye shes dkyil 'khor/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma/ phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ 'byung ba bzhi rnams rab tu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ rdul dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen mo/ shin tu phra ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed/ dag byed chen mo/ las thams cad grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrog pa/ sgra sgrog dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ma/ rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba/ ye shes snying po/ bde ba chen mo'o/ /de la <'di ni thabs kyi dum bu3gt; 'di ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi gnas so/ /de skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /de nas he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu sgrub/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog gyur gsungs/ /ma mo 'dus pa nyams dga'i gnas/

/ā li zla ba kā li nyi/ hūṃ gi ye shes rdo rje sems/ / phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rnams spro ba/ /sngags 'dir mgon po bskul bar bya/ /oṃ badzra satwa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho su ra ta st+waṃ dṛ shya ho/ rdo rje zhe sdang bdag nyid ni/ / nag po hūṃ sgrog bandhu'i mig /rdo rje thod pas lag sbrel ba/ /rtse gsum srin po'i mgrin pa btsir/ khro mo'i dbang phyug sku la 'khyud/ /mi lpags rlon pa'i na bzar bcas/ /skra ser gyen du 'khyil ba'o/ /gau <zhi ba > ri tsau ri <drag mo snying 'dren pa > rab rmongs <pa'i rmongs > dang*/ / <rnam par 'gyur ba > ro langs sbos <gar gyi tshul/> mo za <ra bo 'dogs pa'i > nus ma/ /dur <shi ba slong ba'i tshul > khrod ma dang <ro ldan pa'i tshul > gtum mo rnams/ /sngo dang ser mo btsod kyis mdog/gnag dang dmar ser ljang khu dang*/ /sngo bsangs de bzhin ser skya'o/ gau ri keng rus <mig zim bu 'dod pas myos pa lta bu'i zhi ba'i lta stangs/ > dbyug pa dang*/ /thod pa g.yas dang g.yon par bsnams/ /tsau <drag mo'i 'bru tshugs su lta ba lta stangs > ri mda' gzhu 'gengs byed ma/ /rab rmongs <kyi lta stang chang gis bzi ba lta bur mi gsal > bar lta ba/ rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje dang ni byis pa'i ro/ /ro langs ma <shi ba slong ba'i lta stangs cung zad gyen du lta ba/> yi g.yas g.yon na'o/ /sbos mo <kar gyi lta ba g.yas g.yon du res kyi lta ba/> rgyu ma 'dren par byed/ za nus <phus 'debs grangs :rnam g.yeng [rnams phyogs ]kyi lta ba phyogs bcur lta ba'o/> rdo rje thod pa'o/ /snying dang snying gis bkang ba yis/ /thod <ro za ba'i lta ba mdun steng 'og tu res kyis lta ba/> pas brel ba dur khrod ma/ /mgo <dbugs 'byin phyogs bcur lta ba'o/> /dang lus 'dzin gtum mo'o/ /oṃ dzwa la dzwa la/ bhyoḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ snying po'o/ /oṃ e hye hi ru lu ru lu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/

oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ e a ralli dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ḍā ki nī ā karṣa ya ā karṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ hṛ da ya hūṃ phaṭa dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ṭākki hūṃ dzaḥ dgug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra sarba duṣtan sa ma ye mu tra pra bhañdza ka hūṃ phaṭa/ zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ba ṭa ba mu kha ā karṣa ya ā karṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣā ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī nāṃ hṛ da yaṃ/ ha ha hi hi oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dbang du sdud pa'o/ /sha chen myos byed ba glang sha /khrag bcas he ru ka mchod na/ /he ru ka dgyes dngos grub mchog /dur khrod chen por stsol bar mdzad/ /yang gsung pa/ khru ni nyi shu'i tshad ldan pa/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dbus su gzugs brnyan dgod par bya/ /zhal bzhi gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /rdo rje zhags pa dung dang mda'/ /lcags kyu utpa la dang gzhu/ /de bzhin gdug la sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /padma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /yi ge bcu pa'i gdan las skyes/ /me tog ma dkar de bzhin du/ /spos ma gnag cing mar me ma/ /ser mo dri ma kha dog dmar/ / gnod mdzes ma dang rnam rgyal ma/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu la sogs dgod/ /yang gsungs pa/ hūṃ gi yi ges hūṃ 'don ma/ /rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rab khros phag gi gdong ldan ma/ /rdo rje thod pa lag na thogs/ /gar gyi ro ldan bsgom byas la/ /yi ge hūṃ gis sbyor bzlas pas/ /'od gsal bar ni byed pa dang*/ /bgegs dang nad rnams 'joms pa'o/ /de la <nges don rgyas bshad ni mgon 'dir yod ces pa'i bar ro/> /'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /chos <thabs rig lngas so sor phye ste gsungs pa > rnams rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /'di yi ye shes rdo rje brtag /gzod nas zhi ba gnyis su med/

/nam mkha' nam mkha' ji lta ba'o/ /dpa' bo chen po 'khor lo'i rig pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zab dang rgya che'i rang bzhin no/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /gang rnams sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje 'dzin pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos rnams thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas pa med/ /dbyer med brjod pa dang bral ba/ /sems can dag pa snying rje can/ /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje nyi mas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'di ni bde chen dam pa ste/ /'phel dang 'bri ba yod ma yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam 'phrul ba/ /thams cad rten cing 'byung ba'o/ /dpa' bo chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bden pa ma yin brdzun min dngos/ /'gro 'di rang bzhin yang dag pa/ /ji ltar chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ /mchog tu dga' ba bdag med pa'o/ /dpa' bo chen po ral gri'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / <shes rab btsun mos bsdus te gsungs pa la zhus pa/> /de nas rdo rje snying po sogs/ / sngags rnams bzhengs shing phyag 'tshal te/ /dam tshig chen mo rnal 'byor ma/ / gtso mo che la 'di skad zhus/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar las byung ba/ /nam mkha' nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /sna tshogs chos kun 'byung ba ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mo ci zhig lags/ /nyon <lam mdor bstan ni/> cig rdo rje ji bzhin nyon/ /bdag tu lta ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi stong pa bstan/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ <rgyas bshad dang po snang ba sems ni3gt; /thog med bsags pa'i bag chags kyis/ /sna tshogs zhing dang dbang po dang*/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ro ldan pa/ /dri dang reg bya dang ni lus/ /phyi dang nang du rnam gnas pa/ /thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /'byung ba rnams dang yum med de/ /sems nyid phyi rol snang ba'o/ /kun

<gnyis pa bden pa gnyis su dbye na3gt; rdzob tu ni 'jig rten yod/ /dam pa'i don du gzhan dag med <kun rdzob/> nang <don dam > gi bde ba rang rig pa/ /gsal ba'i dngos po 'di kho <yod/> na/ ༈srid <gsum pa spros bral ni/> med mya ngan 'das pa med/ khams med rnam par shes pa med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa <don > med/ /rgya mtsho lta bu de bzhin nyid/ /sdig dang bsod nams bya las 'das/ /gcig dang du ma'i dngos kyang min/ /thams <bzhi pa gol sa bcad pa ni/> cad dngos po gcig gyur <ni chos nyid > pa/ /ye shes gcig nyid rnam par spros/ /sdug bsngal bde ba yul rnam shes/ /kun las 'das pa'i bde chen po/ /bya ba med cing byed po med/ /ma dkrugs rang bzhin dag pa'o/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar <bde ba chen po > dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags chen po'i ye shes 'dis/ /chags ldan rnams la byang chub ster/ /'khor <don bsdu ni/> ba sems nyid phyi rol dngos po med/ /sems las gzhan du byang chub yod ma yin/ /srid <pa > dang <gsar byung te snying po > zhi bor bral ba snying <bden > po med/ /rang sems snying rje'i bdag nyid mgon <don dam du > 'dir yod/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags dang rgyud 'byung ba/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ na mo bha ga wa te me ru shi kha ra ku ṭa pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ me ru me ru mahā me ru ye swāhā/ oṃ āḥmai tri ye hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra tikṣā dhiḥ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā warbha ni/ dzwa la dzwa la me dha wardha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri buddha wardha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzambha mo ha swāhā/

oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re me dha naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re paṇtā rā ṇi hrīṃḥswāhā/ oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswāhā/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtanta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ni lāmba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ra dzñā pa ya ti hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ dzaṃ dhi ka ṭha ma ho ha ra sarba dha na saṭṭo ratno hūṃ dzuṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma no ha ra ha ra/ oṃ aṅgu sha aṅgu sha hriḥhriḥhriḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya gṛ ba hrīḥ.a haṃ a haṃ aṃ aṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ mahā ka la ha na ha na badzre ṇa ma ma karyaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/ mahā yakṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ hriṃ treṃ kṣaṃ dzaṃ hūṃ ha/ di byā ratnau ga ba ri sha na ar pa ka da pa ya sha /sa ma ya/ ma nu sma ya/ hrīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ maṃ di ri di ri tsaṇḍa hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ gaṃ ga na pa ti ma ma ratna siddhi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga na pa taṃ swāhā/ oṃ ga na baṃ ho yaṃ dzaḥg na baṃ hrīḥyaṃ dzaḥ nyi ma'i gdan la yang dag gnas/ /bgrang 'phreng padma dmar po bsnams/ /gos dkar mo yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom par bya/ /gri gug thod pa lag na thogs/ /phag mo rab khros kha ṭwāṃ bsnams/ /mdzes ma ya ba'i me tog mtshungs/ /dkar mo phyugs bdag zhabs kyis mnan/ /gser mdog mtshan rnams kun rdzogs shing*/ /bdud 'dul phyag rgyas zil gnon pa/ /gau taṃ byang chub chen por bsgom/ /mgo bregs brtul zhugs chen po'o/ /byang chub mchod rten spyi bor 'dzin/ /klu shing dang ni mchog stsol phyag /dong ka'i me tog ltar mdzes pa/ /sangs rgyas rig mar bcas te brtag /mdog dkar 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /ral gri glegs bam phyag na bsnams/ /lte bar rab bsngags 'khor lo bcas/ /gzhon nu'i tshul can bsgom par bya/ /zla ba ltar dkar mchog sbyin dang*/

/po tis mtshan pa chu skyes bcas/ /bsgoms nas shu dag dang bcas pas/ /skyur po 'thungs pas blo gros ster/ /rin chen bum pa snye mar bcas/ /gang gi lag na nyer gnas pa/ /gser can sgrol ma bsam byas na/ / yid bzhin nor bu'i sprin du 'gyur/ /dpag bsam shing brten yal ga dang*/ / nor bu'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa ni/ /gser gyi phug na gnas par bsam/ /nyi ma 'char ka gsar ba'i mdog /lcags kyu utpal dmar po bsnams/ /sgeg 'chang du mas rnam brgyan pa/ /dbang du byed ma bsam par bya/ /dmar mo phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /lcags kyu utpal phyag na bsnams/ /ku ru kulle bsam par bya/ /rdo rje 'chang ba gdan gnon pa/ /sngo bsangs yid tsam khro ba ste/ /sgrub pos mdun du bzhag nas ni/ /mtshan brgyad po ni brjod par bya/ /nag po mi sdug rdo rje can/ /brla gnyis bar du mkha' lding ni/ /dug can a dza ga ra 'joms/ /sdigs byed lag na rdo rje bsgom/ /mdog bzang kā ma rde nu'i ba/ /bi tsu ra 'bras snye ma 'dzin/ /bum pa la gnas gnod sbyin mo/ /marka ṭa zhes bsam par bya/ /padma rā ga'i 'od dang mnyam/ /kyo ba ne'u le'i rkyal pa can/ /nor rgyun ma ni rnam bsgoms na/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ khyi gdong rdo rje lha mo bzhi/ /bsgoms nas gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /gzi brjid rta mchog mtshungs par 'gyur/ /yang na nag po dmar dang dkar/ /rdo rje dbyug tho bcas ral gri/ /thod pa zhags pa thal mor bcas/ /mkha' lding rgyal po rnam par spro/ /phyag gnyis dbyug to 'dzin byas nas/ /nor rgyas tshangs par bcas gzir pa/ /bsgoms na dug rnams bskyod pa dang*/ /sna tshogs las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /mun pa'i sku lus khrag 'dzag zhal/ /ral gri thod bcas sha za ba/ kha ṭwāṃ mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /dug shing la byas mchod par bya/ /dzam bha la ni nor sgrub pa/

/ser po pi dza pu ra 'dzin/ /ne'u le g.yon bsnams bsgoms byas nas/ /chu sbyin dbang po bsgrub par bya/ /rab dmar thod pa'i gdan la gnas/ /cang te thod pa shas gang 'dzin/ /ral pa ldan ma bsgoms byas na/ /sha za mo rnams mngag gzhug 'gyur/ /glang po spre'u rgyal byi ba'i gzugs/ /dgra st+wa la phug phyag na bsnams/ /lcags kyu chang snod bsnams pa yi/ /phyag drug zhabs ni bzhi pa la/ /chung ma g.yog mor bcas bsgoms nas/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po mchod par bya/ /rab dmar mche ba gtsigs pa ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i rab sbyor ba/ /'di yis bgegs rnams 'joms pa dang*/ /blo dang dbang du byed pa yin/ /hrīḥbaṃ hūṃ maiṃ dhiḥ.a taṃ taṃ taṃ hrīḥhūṃ hūṃ baṃ hrīḥhaṃ hūṃ dzi hrīḥgaṃ gaṃ /bdag nyid he ru ka'i sbyor bas gnod gnas dbang po dmar po g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ gnod sbyin mo la 'jug pa bsams nas/ oṃ dzam bha la dza lend+ra ye dha naṃ mi de hi ḍā ki ni dzwā la saṃ bha ra swāhā/ zhes pa 'dis chu sbyin na/ khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /tāṃ yig ye shes las skyes pa/ /zhal bzhi pa la sha yi mdog /phyag gnyis utpal phyag rgya can/ /'phreng ba mda' chen 'khor lo dang*/ /rgyal mtshan gzhu dang bum pa 'dzin/ /lha mo sgrol ma bsam par bya/ / 'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung bar 'gyur/ /sngags 'dis bza' bca' ror bcas 'bul/ /na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa naṃ/ he he bha ga ba te mahā sa twā sarba buddha a ba lo ki te/ mā bi lamba mā bi lamba i daṃ bā ling gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba bi pañtsa re swāhā/ zla ba nyi ma sman dang dri/ /mar khu sgron ma lngas bcas pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas bza' ba dang*/ /tsa ru de bzhin gtor ma bya/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs kyis bum pa la bzlas te nad pa la bkrus na/ nad nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /thig gu la mdud pa byas shing*/

shing bu la bsngags la a zhes bzlas pas chom po bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /phag mo'i sngags 'bum bzlas te dkyil 'khor sindhu ras byug pa byas la/ oṃ āḥbadzra na ra ka hraṃ khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa zhag bdun gyis rmi lam du zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas skar ma rgyal la mchod rten dmar po byas la tshes brgyad la utpal gyi 'khor lo kha sbyor byas la/ bum par bcug nas bskul ba dang bcas pa bzlas pas gang dbang du bya ba de 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ / byis pa'i sngags kyis bzlas pa'i chus 'khrud pa dang*/ sa dkar la bzlas te ril bu byas pa dang*/ bsrung skud byas pa de dag ni nad dang gdon las thar pa dang*/ mtshams med pa byas pa'ang ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ku ru kulle'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas gtsang po'i chu zangs ma'i snod du blangs te de la gnod sbyin mo rin po che dang lcags kyu 'dzin par bsams nas/ oṃ uṣṇī ṣa ya dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swāhā/ oṃ dzambhe mo he hṛ da yaṃ wardha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nangs par sum brgya bzlas nas khrus byas na thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lha mo bai ta li ser mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par bsams nas/ oṃ bai ta lī pu tra siddhi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /sarba dza ya/ dngul chur bcas pa rna bar bzhag na mtshon gyis chod par mi 'gyur ro/ /rang nyid gdugs dkar mo can du bsgoms nas/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba buddha a dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭhi te sarba ta thā ga tā uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje dang gnod mdzes kyi rig sngags grub pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo ba'i rdo rje'am/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje byas la bzlas pas 'bar bar gyur nas sa 'og gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/

srad bu la sogs pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcom nas dpal gyi sgo'am/ bu ga'i sgo rnams su 'jug ste/ stobs can dang gzhan len la sogs pas mchod par byed do/ /ji ltar sa 'og gi rtog pa las bshad pa de bzhin no/ /dpa' bo gshin rje gshed po ni/ /nag po dbyug pa zhags pa bsnams/ /ma he la gnas bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ya mānta ka hūṃ bzlas/ /re mig dgu pa khang pa lnga/ khang pa bcu gnyis dag dang bcas/ /hrīḥṣtiḥl sogs dag gis bskor/ /'di yis drag shul spyod kun bsgrub/ /yakṣe ma med da dza sa do ru/ /ṇa yo ni rā yatstsha ni ra/ /gzhan yang gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa sgrub bo/ /oṃ yo yakṣi ṇī bī ra dze swāhā/ shang leb la gos 'dzin pa mo bris la skye gnas su gzir bas bzlas na 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs nas kyang ci bgyi byed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bha ga wa te swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing la sogs par gzugs brnyan bya'o/ /gnod sbyin mo nor can gyi'o/ /na mo bai shra ma ṇa/ ta ya na ḍa ku be rā ya/ dī bya bi mā na tsi ra ta ya/ he ma mā la kunṭa la/ sha ri ta ya/ yakṣa pa/ bandha ya tt+waṃ bha ga wān/ ā warta li ṣya mi/ tadya thā/ oṃ ma ṇi ma ṇi kuṭṭa kuṭṭa/ ku ku ku ku/ pa ra pa ra/ pu ra pu ra/ ku be ra ku be ra na ḍa ku be rā dī bya ma na kunḍa li ku bi ku bi swāhā/ na ḍa mo yi'o/ /oṃ na ḍa bi na ḍe dha ri ṇi swāhā/ na ḍa pho'i 'o/ /yakṣa ki li ki lo na mo satt+ya pa di tiṭṭa pra taḥ ta sha tyaḥ paṇḍi da da mi se ma ka mā na pra yatstshantu swāhā/ ki li ki li'i 'o/ /phuḥhaṃ phuḥklu mo mtha' yas ma'i 'o/ /oṃ hrīḥdza/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i 'o/ /na mo bha ga wa te pu lu pa lā ya/ pi sha tsi/ paṅkha bhudha te/ sa mo ka ma na/ pra yatstshantu/ tadya thā/ hu lu hu lu/ pi shā tsa/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra da ba ra da/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsu ṭu tsu ṭu na maḥswāhā/ sha za pi lu pa'i 'o/ /na mo bha ga wa te pi shā tsā ya/ aṃ ka ka na pi shā tsa dha ri ma ni swāhā/

sha za nor bu 'dzin pa'i 'o/ /oṃ kṛṣṇa pi shā tsa ya sa ra sa ra sarba artha na mo swā dha ya swāhā/ sha za nag mo'i 'o/ /a lu ke be le ke gṛhṇa baṇḍa bi shā tsi ni swāhā/ e lu ka'i 'o/ /oṃ kha ra mu kha pe shā tsi nī hi hi da da pa ya swāhā/ bong gdong ma'i 'o/ /oṃ ta ti le ta ti li kṛṣṇa mu khe mahā pi shā tsi de hi de hi dā swāhā/ dus kyi gdong gi'o/ /tshe ring bcud len ri lu sogs/ /'gro ba pho mo 'gugs pa dang*/ /lkog gyur shes pa ston la sogs/ /de bzhin gser gyi 'dod pa ster/ de

<mi g.yo dbugs dbyung > nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa khros pa rdo rje gtum po spros pa ni/ hūṃ ral gri zhags pa bsnams pa'i mchog /skra ser mkhrang la grims pa'i lus/ /ma rungs gtum po cher 'khrugs pa/ /mdog nag mig yon spro ba che/ /oṃ tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ me yis bgegs rnams skrod pa dang*/ sngags bzlas chu yis srung ba'am/ 'phar ma gnyis pa'i 'khor lor bris/ 'di yis bris sku byas nas ni/ khro rgyal rtag tu gtor mas mchod/ yungs dkar chu dang pu ta lis/ /bgegs rnams nyams par byed pa dang*/ /dpung rnams gnon dang dbye ba dang*/ /bsad pa la sogs rab bya ste/ /gtum po khros dang gtum po yi/ /dam tshig 'byung ba la sogs par/ /mi g.yo rgyal po nyid kyis gsungs/ /sngon tshe lha mo bde ldan dang*/ / sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs 'dus pa las/ /bdag dang ming po mi g.yo btsas/ / dgra bcom rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bdud dang lha min gyis nyams byas/ / lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /mig yon mgon gyis lha min dbang*/ khrag khrig bcu gnyis rab gtubs nas/ /de de'i chung ma kun 'dod byas/ /mi dang dri za mi'am ci/ /gnod sbyin klu rnams srog bcom ste/ /thams cad mi 'khrugs zhing du 'phangs/ /kun gyi ming yang mi 'khrugs rgyal/ /mi g.yo chags chen gyur pa yis/ /sring mo dag dang ma yang bsten/ /bde ba'i bde ba mchog de yis/ / sangs rgyas mi g.yo mgon por gyur/ /mi g.yos dgra bcom rnams la smras/ / bud med spangs pa'i sdig pa las/ /shes rab spangs shing bde spangs pa/ /snying rje shin tu dman par byas/ /shes rab snying rje gang spangs pa/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dam chos dang*/ /dge 'dun yang ni rnam spangs pas/ /dge slong bud med smod byed pa/ /sdom pas dman zhing sdig dang bcas/ /bud med sbyor las sdom brtson nyid/ /gzhan ni tshangs spyod med pa'i phyir/ /mgo bregs sgyu mas 'jig rten bslu/

khyed cag sring mo'i dam tshig gyis/ /de tshe gling bzhi'i dge slong gtso/ / bud med dam tshig bde ba yis/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rnam snang la sogs rab tu grags/ /dus 'dir ming po gau taṃ ste/ /go sā sring mo sgrol ma bdag /bud med brgyad khri'i bde ba yis/ /longs spyod khyim du sa bcu thob/ /de nas zhing du kun 'dar gyis/ /spyod pa yongs su spyod pa na/ /'jig rten kun tu rgyu zhes rtog /dga' mo dang ni dga' stobs ma/ /zas bcas snyoms 'jug bde ba yis/ /dbang bskur rdzogs sangs rgyas pa nyid/ /mi g.yo khros pas bdud bcom nas/ /bdud kyi bu mo rab bkram rnams/ /'dod chen spyad pas rjes su bzung*/ /drag shul spyod dang 'khrig sbyor las/ /byang chub lam gzhan yod min yang*/ /blo chen chags bral byams pa la/ /mos phyir rgyal bas sgyu ma mdzad/ /bud med bdag sgrub de yis ni/ /ming po la sogs mnyes par bya/ /mi g.yo rgyal po'i dam tshig gis/ /rnal 'byor pa gang sring mo dang*/ /bu mo ma yang mchod par bya/ /yugs sa mo kun bde ba yis/ /dga' bar byas na mi g.yo mnyes/ /mi gang nga la mchod byed pa/ khro bo gtum pos byin gyis rlobs/ /mi g.yo ba'i dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba bha ya sha ma ni sarba durga ti tā ra ṇi tu re swāhā/ seṅge la sogs pa bsrung ba'o/ /oṃ dī ra da/ ba da ni e ka daṃṣti mahā na se lambo dha ri ka ṭa da ha ṭa ḍa ha trā sa ya trā sa ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ glang po che la sogs pa bsrung ba'o/ /oṃ shi khī ba da ne mahā u ka la mu khī dzwa la mā li ni sapta dzi hri wā/ sapta mu khī bi shwa na rī tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ me'i 'jigs pa bsrung ba'o/ /oṃ pha nī mahā pha ni kṛṣṇa ne tre e ka da na dzi hwī ka ro ṇa/ tsa lā ya tsa lā ya mahā bi ṣa bhakṣi ni tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/

sbrul la sogs pa las bsrung ba'i 'o/ /oṃ kharga hāsti bhṛ ku ṭi mu khī uddha ke sha mahā na dhi kṛ ṣṇa añdzan bharṇa tshinda tshinda bhinda bhinda utta ra ya utta ra ya tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ chom rkun la sogs pa bsrung ba'i 'o/ /oṃ rakta warṇe pā shāṅku sha hasti ma hā ra wi/ mahā ba la sa ra sa ra bi sa ra bi sa ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa ā kang ha ka ḍa da ha mahā durga na mu tsā lā tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ lcags sgrog las skyob pa'i 'o/ /oṃ dza le dza le mahā dza le tā ra ya tā ra ya/ uttā ra ya uttā rā ya/ shṛṅkha la hasti mahā dza we e ka bī ri mahā kā ru ṇi tā re tutta re tu re sāhā/ chu las skyob mi'i 'o/ /oṃ mahā gambhitt+yai mahā ka ru ṇi ke bha ga waṃ bā le bha ra dha a bha yi hasti tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ sha za las bsrung ba'o/ /'khor lo ljang khu rtsibs brgyad pa/ /dbus su bsgrub bya dgod par bya/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /sngags kyi grong khyer bdag pos bskor/ /ljang khus bsrung bar 'gyur ba ste/ /'chi ba bslu byed dkar po'o/ /nad dang brtson las thar pa dang*/ /tshe dang longs spyod brtson 'grus dang*/ /dbang phyug dang ni blo gros 'phel/ /tshwa la gi haṃ dri chu dang*/ /sa dang tsi tra ka dpa' bo/ /gla rtsi ro tshan ril lu yis/ /dug rnams srung bar byed pa ste/ /bzlas dang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /paṇḍi ta kar rtsa ba dang*/ /be'u'i gc-i bas dug rengs byed/ /rim gsum rtsibs ni bcu drug pa/ /ku ru kulle'i sngags kyis dgang*/ kha sbyor gzugs brnyan sbyor ba bya/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis gsang gnas phug /tshwar bcas gcin gyis kha bkang nas/ /rgya shug me la gdung bar bya/ /me tog bsnun dang zas dang spos/ /mig sman sbyor bas dbang du bya/ /sgrol ma dkar mor bsam byas nas/ /mi smra bar ni 'bum bzlas so/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i sbyor las byung*/

/yid gzhungs ma sogs bzhi dang bcas/ hal tya li dong ra zi ra/ /grog sman ru rta la la phud/ /ra yi 'o ma mar bcas btung*/ /shu dag hal tyai'i bzlas zos na/ /'dis ni blo gros 'phel bar 'gyur/ /maṇḍal mchod nas mi 'jigs rgya/ /spyi bor reg pa chom rkun bsrung*/ /gu gul dā la'i 'dab ma dang*/ /ru rta gla rtsi dpa' bo sbyar/ /shu dag shing kun sbyar ba las/ /ril bu 'bum bzlas za bar bya/ /dri chu gla bas gnas lngar bsrung*/ /mdze nad gso bar byed pa'i mchog /me tog bhridga rā dzar bcas/ /sna yis rngubs na rgas pa sel/ /lo gsum bud med sbyor ba yis/ khu ba bkag pas gzhon nur byed/ /rna bar dug dang na le sham/ /lo gcig lon pas 'on pa sel/ /rgya mtsho'i sbu ba rgya mtsho'i 'bras/ /ra gcin sbyar ba mig nad 'joms/ /oṃ sum bhi ro dha na ye swāhā/ /kaṣto'i rus pa bya rog mig /gser gyi phur mas 'bog nad bsrung*/ /dkyil 'khor lcags kyu ldan par bya/ /mchod na btson las thar bar 'gyur/ /halti gi haṃ kasthu ri/ /rtsa sngags bum par gdags byas la/ /nam gung sbrum ma bkru bar bya/ /nad med bde bas btsa' bar 'gyur/ /bo dhi rtsi 'bras mar dang bsres/ /bzlas nas bud med la byin te/ khrus byas mo gsham gzugs 'chang ba'ang*/ /nges par bu dang bcas par 'gyur/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gdags byas la/ /maṇḍal mchod dang bzlas pa dang*/ khrus ni nyin re nyin re bya/ /byis pa 'tsho ba'i dam pa yin/ yang gsungs pa/ lte bar hrīḥ brgyad bung ba'i gzugs/ /spro zhing de yis bcud gzhib bya/ /dzaḥho hūṃ a baṃ hi/ ā karṣa ya aṅku sha dzaḥ dpral bar thig le byas na ni/ / bud med thams cad dbang du byed/ /yang gsungs pa/ nam <bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor > mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus byas par/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /cho ga shes pas der <slob dpon gyi3gt; dbang bskur <chung ba > sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/

/rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung*/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /skyes pa de bzhin gshegs ye shes/ /bud med rig pa'i lha mor bya/ /bu mo bcu drug lo lon 'khyud/ /bde ba bsgom pa slob dpon no/ /gsang 'di su la'ang brjod mi bgyi/ /gal te smras na de yi tshe/ /shin tu rno ba'i shū la ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi phyag na gnas/ /gang gi dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu 'bigs/ /bha ga 'jib bcas tsā ru bza'/ /gsang ba'i dbang de gnyis pa'o/ /ston pas bu la gtad byas nas/ /snyoms par 'jug pas ro mnyam bsgom/ /sa bcu'i bde ba thob pa na/ /shes rab ye shes zhes brjod do/ /chags <dbang bzhi pa'i mdor bstan tshig drug3gt; dang chags bral las 'das pa/ /dbu mar mi dmigs 'od gsal ba/ /mi 'gyur rtag pa mchog tu phra/ /bzhi pa'i ye shes 'gro 'ong med/ /gnyis sbyor brtul zhugs chen po pa/ /bde ba che grub slob dpon te/ /chags ldan g.yo sgyus bud med smod/ /lhung bzed 'gengs byed slob dpon min/ /sa chog slob dpon bya ba dang*/ /dbang bskur dam tshig sbyin sreg dang*/ /rab gnas mchod yon cho ga dang*/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /dgang blugs de bzhin phyag rgya drug/sku gzugs tshad dang tha ma'i chog/phyir bzlog bsrung ba bzlas pa dang*/ /nad dang gdon dang rim 'joms dang*/ /tshe dang longs spyod rigs 'phel dang*/ /dbang du byed dang bsad dang skrod/ /dbye dang mnan pa lha khang gi /cho ga 'di rnams slob dpon las/ /de bzhin bcud len rig 'dzin dang*/ /sna tshogs las dang dngos grub dang*/ /sman gyi sbyor ba rnam mang po/ /rgyud dang rgyud du mngon par brjod/ kha sbyor rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /gdan bzhi de bzhin rdo rje gur/ /'byung dang zla gsang thig le dang*/ /mi g.yo gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /sna tshogs sgrol ma'i rgyud chen dang*/

/ku ru kulle ral gcig ma/ /bcu gcig rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ kun gyi sbyor ba rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan rnams gang rnams de dag ni/ /sna tshogs rgyud dang rgyud du shes/ /rtsod ldan dus su gang bstan pa/ /de dag thams cad bsdus pa'o/ /'on <dbang bzhi pa'i rgyas bshad 'di nas gsungs po'i bar > kyang gzhan rnams su sbas <dbang bzhi pa/> pa/ /'dir ni gang dag sngon gsungs pa'i/ /mi shes byis pa rnams la yang*/ /rtag tu gnas pa'i bde chen po/ /bzhi pa'i ye shes 'gyur ba med/ /rang byung chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /rkyen las byung dang mi rtag phyir/ /shes rab ye shes bzhi pa min/ /las dang ye shes phyag rgya ni/ /dam pa'i don du don ma yin/ /don dam brtag pa kun dang bral/ /de phy-ir smra bar nus ma yin/ /'jig rten 'dod pas rab g.yengs dang*/ /chags bral rnams kyi dben pa dang*/ /zhal phyag rnam pa'i yid bde dang*/ /thig le phra mo'i bde sgrub dang*/ /lte ba'i re kha bsgom 'bad bcas/ /stong nyid mthong bas rab dga' dang*/ /rlung rnams thim pa'i sems med bde/ /'gro don byed 'gyur rab dga' dang*/ /bud med sbyor ba'i reg bde dang*/ /yid dang gzugs brnyan bde ba ste/ /'di dag skyon dang bcas pa yin/ /rang bzhin bde chen gzhan pa nyid/ /lus dang ngag yid nges dang bcas/ /chags dang chags pa bar ma dang*/ /chags bral bcas pa'ang yi ger bcas/ /dga' ba dang ni mchog tu dga'/ /bral dga' g.yo bcas mi brtan pa/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rig pa po/ /gsal dang mi gsal brda tsam ste/ /de dag de la snying po med/ /chags pa la ni chags dngos med/ /chags bral la yang chags bral med/ /dbu ma las kyang dbu ma med/ /thams cad rkyen las byung ba tsam/ /dngos dang dngos po kun bral ba/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid dngos/ /'di yi rang bzhin mi 'gyur bde/ /dpe med yi ge med pa dang*/ /g.yo ba med dang 'gyur ba med/ / <gzhan stong >

rang rig bde chen rang bzhin gyis/ /mya ngan 'das pa gcig pu bden/ kun byed 'di la byed po med/ /bdag dang sems can srog bcas dang*/ /gtso bo dbang phyug rdul phran sogs/ /ye shes 'di la rnam par brtags/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /'gog dang lam bden chen po pa/ /dri ma sngon nas zad pa dang*/ /chos kun gdod nas sangs rgyas pa/ /bden gnyis dbyer med tshul 'di bstan/ /ji ltar me mar khang par bus/ /skar khung lnga las phyir snang ba/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i me mar 'dod/ /dbang shes lnga zhes rnam par sprul/ /me mar lnga zhes yid kyis rtog /'od dang me gzhan yin no zhes/ /yid gzhan blun pos ngar 'dzin byed/ /chu las chu rlabs ji bzhin ltos/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas chos gang gang de/ /sems can <bde gshegs snying po yon tan can/> khams la re rer gnas/ /dbye ba med cing mthong med pa/ /gser khams rdo la gnas pa bzhin/ /lus dang ngag sems 'khrig pa ste/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi mngon gyur pa/ /gzugs brnyan brag cha nam mkha'i dngos/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ /lte ba mgrin pa snying padma/ /yang ni mgo bor rab brjod pa/ /sems can srid gsum 'byung ba dang*/ /'di nyid du ni thim pa'o/ /dbang bskur ba rdo rje ye shes kyis de skad ces gsungs so/ <'di nas shes rab kyi dum bu/ > de nas rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa rnams dang*/ ma mo rnams dang*/ dbang phyug ma rnams dang*/ lha dang mi dang klu dang dri za dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang mi'am ci mo la sogs pa'i/ bud med ri rab grangs med pa/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rdul snyed rnams the tshom du gyur yid gnyis su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dbugs dbyung ba ni ji ltar bstan/ /dus 'dir nyung du gsung ba ci/ chags chen nges par gsungs pa gang*/ /rig sngags bzlas pa byed rnams kyis/

/ji ltar lha la bsten par bgyid/ /rlung gi sbyor bas lus dag pa/ /de bzhin dga' ba la sogs ci/ /mchog gyur bud med dam tshig dang*/ /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /grol ba'i bdag nyid gang yin pa/ /lha lags mgon pos bshad du gsol/ /'di la rig pa'i brtul zhugs ci/ /btsan thabs sbyor ba'ang ji ltar 'gyur/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa dag/mngon par 'grub pa'ang bshad du gsol/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis bstan to/ /'di la dang por rdo rje sems/ /phyi nas de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid rnams bsdus nas/ /rig ma btsun mo rnam par rol/ /chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams gnas pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam rol ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par bskyed/ /bdag nyid bde ba che rang bzhin/ /sems can khams la rjes zhugs pas/ /thams cad bde chen byang chub thob/ /bde bas mngon par zhen rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis stong nyid bstan/ /de des grangs med mngon byang chub/ /phyi nas stong par mngon zhen rnams/ /thams cad dmyal bar lhung gyur pas/ /rgyal ba rtag pa rnam sprul te/ / dbu ma la ni rnam par bzhag /rang dang gzhan don cher bsgrub pas/ /dpag yas mchog tu grol bar byas/ /kun rdzob rjes zhugs ngar 'dzin can/ /rnam rtog du mas rnam dkrugs pa/ /de dag gzhan gyi bsam pa kun/ /rdzogs byed bya ba mchog la bskul/ /rin chen nyi ma rnam sprul pas/ /de dag bla med byang chub la/ /mchog tu dga' bas gzhol bar 'gyur/ /gzhan las rjes su chags ldan pa/ /de tshe 'dod chags kyis bcings pas/ /padma gar dbang rnam sprul te/ /'dod chags bde ba'i lam gyis ni/ /brjod med 'gro ba mngon byang chub/ /phyi nas bde la chags ldan rnams/ /le los mngon par nyams gyur nas/

/blo ngan 'jig rten rnam par 'khrugs/ /rta mchog rgyal po rab sprul nas/ /sems can brtson 'grus gnas la bzhag /byi bo rkun po dgra la sogs/ /rang rang tshul gyis mngon sprul bas/ /thams cad rdo rje'i gnas la bzhag /rtsod ldan spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ /shin tu khro gtum gdug pa can/ /rab khros he ru kar sprul pa/ /drag shul gsod la dgyes pa 'gyur/ / srin po gnod sbyin 'byung po gnod/ /ma mo bcom byas rig sngags dang*/ /rdzas dang mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor dang*/ /sman gyis kyang ni thams cad bcom/ /zhe sdang gdug gnon zhi ba'i phyir/ /slar yang bde chen mgon po la/ /ma 'ongs dus na rab 'jug ste/ /dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor dam pa'o/ /'dir ni don dam kun rdzob ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa zhes/ /gzhan ni rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /'dir yang don dam rnam pa gnyis/ /bde ba che dang de nyid do/ /kun rdzob gnyis kyang 'jig rten dang*/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni re zhig bzhag /tshe thung bsod nams zhan pa dang*/ /srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang*/ /'dod la spyod pas g.yengs gyur pa/ /da ltar rgyud rnams nyung ngur gsungs/ /bskal pa grangs med sum cu gnyis/ /'bad kyang da dung byang chub med/ /bde bas tshe 'dir 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de phyir 'dod chags chen po bstan/ /bde bas bde ba thob 'gyur te/ / sangs rgyas bde ba bde chen po/ /'bras bu dang mtshungs rgyu sgrub pa/ /ma tshang stong pas mya ngan 'di'i/ /sdig pa med dang dad pa dang*/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang*/ /ser sna dregs dang nga rgyal med/ /'dis ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga dag byas pa yang*/ /'di yis sgrub pa por 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /bgegs 'joms bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ni/ /dang por 'bum phrag bzlas byas nas/ /mchod rten la sogs byed pa dang*/

/mchod dang bskor ba la sogs bya/ /yan lag mchog dang dang ldan pa'i/ /bud med yid 'ong yang na gzhan/ /sngags spyod snying rje blo ldan pa/ / snying stobs ldan pa grogs zhes bya/ /bram ze mu stegs nyan thos med/ /dang po'i las can der gnas bya/ /bris sku mchod pa dang bcas shing*/ /dang por rigs kyi lha nyid bsgom/ /bye ba bye bar bzlas la brtson/ /phyi nas dkyil 'khor rnam bsgoms nas/ /bzlas pa 'bum du bya ba yin/ /sbyin sreg mchod la mngon par brtson/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes pa bris nas ni/ /zla ba drug tu mchod par bya/ /sngags pa sngags dang de bzhin grogs/ /phyogs dus rdzas dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /lha ni bdun par gsungs pa yin/ /dam tshig brtson 'grus bzod pa dang*/ /dad dang snying rje sngags ma nyams/ /le lo med na myur thob 'gyur/ /lha dang rigs sngags mthu ldan zhing*/ /sems stobs ldan dang mtshan ma thob/ /'di yis dngos grub bsgrub bya yi/ /gzhan du na ni nyon mongs 'gyur/ /g.yon nas lta bas dgang ba dang*/ /g.yas kyi dgug pa de bzhin no/ /dpral ba'i lta ba re tsa ka /sna rtser bum pa can yin no/ /lte ba las ni rlung bskyed pa/ /me nyid dang ni rlung nyid dang*/ /de bzhin chu dang dbang chen te/ /'khor lo sems kyi kun spyod pas/ /steng logs thad ka 'og tu gnas/ /srog nyid dang ni thur sel dang*/ /gyen rgyu khyab byed me mnyam gnas/ /'khor lo kun tu 'gro spyod pa/ /klu dang rus sbal sogs de bzhin/ /snye ma la sogs rnam par gnas/ /mig dang rna ba dang ni sna/ /lce dang lus la byang chub sems/ /de bzhin sgo ni dgu dang yang*/ /grong bzhi dang ni sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo ni dam pa gnyis nyid dang*/ /dman pa'i sgo ni rnam pa gnyis/ /byed pa bcings pas sgo phye zhing*/ /yur ba las ni chu 'bab ltar/ /de bzhin rlung gi sbyor ba yis/ /lus ni dag par byed pa yin/ /sgrub po'i dbang po gang zhig dge bsnyen nam dge tshul lam dge slong yang rung ste/

shin tu dben pa'i ri bo'am nags tshal lam/ skyed mos tshal lam khyim du gnas pas/ lang tsho ldan ma gzhon nu ma'am/ dar bab ma blangs te/ gzugs bzang mig mdzes skra bzang ba/ /lam 'dir blo brtan rnyed nas ni/ /mchog tu dga' ba rab tu brtsams/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod ma chags shing*/ /bde la mngon par rjes chags pa/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa mthong dga' ba/ /de las sbyor ba'i dngos grub thob/ /lus ni rab tu brtas ldan pa/ /dga' ba'i tshig 'jam rol mo dang*/ /'khyud dang tsum pa ta nu 'drud/ /ze 'bru 'dab ldan bskul ba yis/ /g.yo dang brtan nyams dga' bar rengs/ /mig zum 'gyur ba bdag nyid la/ /las mang 'bras bu bde chung bas/ /cha shas bde ba dga' dang po/ /steng dang 'og tu rnam bltas nas/ /brlan bcas padma rab rgyas par/ /rdo rje rgyas pa rab bcug pas/ /'dar dang 'gyur dang sīta kyi sgra/ /u yig drod bcas sgra nyams pa/ /bu mos ye shes thob 'gyur te/ /rtsol bral khyab pa'i bde ba ni/ /mchog tu dga' bar yang dag brjod/ /rab bskyod gnyis kyis bskyod pa las/ /du ba'am rgod dam byis pa'i tshul/ /'dod pas mi bzod dran nyams pa/ /bdag gi ye shes bde gsal ba/ /rang bzhin bral 'di lhan skyes dga'/ /nyams pa bral ba'i dga' spangs nas/ /ye shes mchog gis dgag par bya/ /yang na btsan thabs sbyor bas so/ /rdo rje 'khums dang chu skyes zum/ /bde ba rjes dran bral ba'i dga'/ /mchog tu bcings pa rnam pa bdun/ /phrag par rkang pa zung ster dang*/ /steng dang 'og dang thad ka rgyab/ / shin tu brkyang dang bsnol ba'o/ /rdzas kyis thig le'i rim gror byas/ /skye gnas dam dang tsha ba yis/ /sbyor ba thams cad bya bar bya/ /'di yis ye shes rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhing na gnas pa'i bud med rnams/ /'dod chen sbyor bas mnan bya yis/ /me tog sogs kyis mchod mi dgos/ /sbyor ba gang gis rdo rje dang*/ /padma sad pa de bsten bya/

/chu skyes dbus su sems phyung la/ /de yi ye shes mtshon byas nas/ /me tog bcas pa lidgas btung*/ /ra sa ya ṇa'i bde ba'o/ /rab tu dga' sogs gnas byas nas/ /'gyur ba med kyang 'gyur bar ston/ khu ba phyed kyi shes rab ma'i/ /'khor lo 'gro 'ong sad par byed/ / gzugs mdzes ltas dang dga' ba'i sgro/ /dri mnam ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi btung*/ /reg dang gnyis gnyis sprod pa dang*/ /rdo rje bslang ba bha ga yis/ / 'tshir dang zil pas gsher ba dang*/ /drod dang g.yo ba rnam shes gsum/ /rab dga' la sogs sar brjod pa/ /phung po rin chen snod du sbas/ /dang po'i las can rnams la ni/ /bud med spangs pas ye shes med/ /dang po tha mar gnyis sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas bde ba rab tu 'grub/ /nus bral slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /padmar sems ni mngon dbab pas/ /bde gshegs mchod par bya ba nyid/ /gzhan du byung na dngos grub ring*/ /bud med dag kyang 'dis grol te/ /sor mo shing dang lpags pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor dag gis rtsa sad bya/ / 'dod chen bud med rab grol phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud rgyas par phye/ /bde ba skyed byed bdun bcu gnyis/ /bud med rnams kyi lhag pa'i rtsa/ /bud med myur du byang chub pa/ /skyes bu de bzhin min pa nyid/ /'du shes gzhan dang ma rdzogs dang*/ /mi dmigs 'di las lhung med de/ /'dod bcas sad dang rmi lam la/ /'dzag byed de dag nyes dang bcas/ /dus bzhir bzang mo la 'dod spyod/ / dam tshig rnams kyi gtso bo'i gtso/ /zla re'am lo ni re re ru/ /padma mchod par mi byed na/ /de tshe dam tshig nyams pa yis/ /tsha ba chen por rnam par lhung*/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bud med kun/ /mchod cing gus pas phyag bya'o/ /dud 'gro mo la'ang gus bya na/ /mi mo ci phyir gus mi byed/ /shes rab bud med mi mo'i gzugs/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang*/ /lha dang bla ma grogs gyur pa/ /rab tu byams ldan gnyen gshin la/

/mi shes byas pa mi gzo bas/ /skye gnas dman ces rnam smod pa/ /nad dang rims nad tshe thung dang*/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed pa 'gyur/ /mi shes sngags pa bud med la/ /snun byed dam tshig kun nyams pas/ /skad cig de la mnar med lhung*/ /sdug pa'i spun gyi dgrar gyur na/ /spun zla mchod kyang dgar mi 'gyur/ /bud med smod la lha mo rnams/ /mi dges de yi mchod mi len/ / bskal ba bye ba grangs med par/ /bzang por spyod pa kho nas kyang*/ /byang chub rin chen ma thob pa/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis thob par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid bsgom zhing*/ /phyag rgya'i bde ba rab sgrub pa/ / bud med sbyor las phyag rgya che/ /mngon du mtshon par byed na de/ khrus dang gtsang sgra mi dgos shing*/ /dka' spyad sdom pa med par yang*/ /bde ba nyid dang dga' bas 'grub/ /de bas ci ltar 'dod spyod cing*/ /kun bzang de bzhin thams cad spyod/ /g.yo ba dag kyang ci dgar byed/ /ji lta bus kyang rnam grol 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan lugs ma la sogs las/ /rnal 'byor skye bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro/ /g.yo dang smra ba spyod pa kun/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho gar 'gyur/ /mar me legs par blangs nas ni/ /mun pa'i khrod gnas nor bu len/ /sgrib pa'i mun par chos kyi dbyings/ /bud med bde bas 'tshol bar bya/ /shin tu nye bar gnas pa rnams/ /de de'i chos la mi gus pa/ /mkhyen nas rgyal bas chags bral bstan/ /dam pa'i don du de nyid min/ yang gsungs pa/ dang por mtshan dus gsangs te spyad/ /gal te der sems mi brtan na/ /bsdus nas tha mal tshul du rol/ /gzhan du smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /sha za bzhin du kun tu 'khyam/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes lnga grub pas/ /'jig rten mngon du yang dag spyad/ /gal te 'phags pa'i sa thob na/

/des ni phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod/ /zhing rnams kun tu rgyu ba'am/ /yang na bas mtha' 'am rang gi khyim/ /sbas pa'i spyod pas grol bar 'gyur/ /yang na tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /bud med bcu gnyis rnam rol pa/ /rgyan dang gdong sogs rnam par brgyan/ /shar gyi bud med dbus 'ongs shing*/ /gcig shos shar du dges rol sogs/ /sna tshogs du mas rnam rol ba/ /skyed mos tshal la sogs par bsgrub/ /glu dang zlos gar kun byas te/ /dbang bskur ba dang las kun bya/ / yang gsungs pa/ rdo rje'i sgo ni dbye ba dang*/ /de bzhin padma rgyas par dbye/ shing ngam sa yi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /bshang ba'i lam du rtse bar bya/ /srog dang de bzhin thur sel ba/ /bkag cing gong bu gcig tu bya/ /dga' bas rol pa la zhugs nas/ /dal bu dal bus rab sbyor te/ /sgo dbye ba dang sor mos gnon/ /bu mos rtsa yi thur ma yis/ /dhū ti rnam par 'byed par 'gyur/ /de yi gnas su rlung rgyas te/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo kun sad pa/ /gtum mo 'bar bcas zhu zhing 'dzag /btsan thabs sbyor bas me 'bar ba/ /rwa sa na las rnam par rgyu/ /'dzag pa'ang la la na las te/ khu ba 'dres gyur kun 'dar du/ /bar byed 'khor lo 'khor lo la/ /lan mang bzlog cing yang 'bar gnas/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga 'bigs par byed/ /de las rnam par ltung ba yis/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rab tu 'grub/ /mngon par byang chub rab bshad pa/ /'byung ba'i bde ba lha mor brtag ༈ /gdol ma bram ze'i bu mo dang*/ /tshong mo glu mkhan mda' mkhan mo/ /gar mkhan mo sogs rigs can bzung*/ /yang na lha mo mi'am ci/ /klu mo dri za mo sogs brtag /thig le zhu ba zla ba'i gzugs/ /me tog dang bcas nyi ma gsol/ /thabs dang shes rab gcig gyur pa/ khu ba khrag dang rlung bcas pa'i/ /tshogs pa 'dir ni rnam par zhig/lus dang sems zhes bya ba 'das/ /kun gzhi rnam par gyur pa nyid/ /'di las longs spyod rdzogs par 'gyur/

/yang na don grub sgyu ma bzhin/ /mā ma ki sogs rab sbyor ba'o/ /sangs rgyas rang nyid gzugs can ni/ /lha mo dang sbyor 'dod chags che/ /'on kyang mos pa tha dad phyir/ /sprul pa mig 'phrul rnam par 'phrul/ ༈ /yang gsungs pa/ oṃ karti ka sarba mā ra ṇaṃ maṃ sa karta ya karta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka pā la sarba shā trun rakṣaṃ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba shā trun tri shū la hūṃ phaṭa/ brtul zhugs so/ /gzugs brnyan yi ge mtshan ma dag/dkyil 'khor gsum du nges byas pa/ /snying ga nas byung snying gar bzhugs/ /mtshon cha phyag rgya phyis bkod nas/ /las dang dngos grub bkas gnang ba/ /bu mo dag la 'khyud pa dang*/ /nu ma mnyed las bde thob pa/ /slob dpon dbang bskur sbyin pa'o/ /zhi ba la sogs pa'i sgrol ma ni dkar ba dang*/ ser ba dang*/ dmar ba dang*/ nag mo'o/ /chu dang dbang chen dang*/ me dang rlung la gnas pa dang*/ ngang pa'i rgyal po dang*/ glang po che dang*/ rta dang*/ ma he la bzhon pa'o/ /zhi ba'i lha mo ni mi 'jigs pa dang*/ utpal dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyas pa mo ni mchog sbyin dang bum pa dang*/ snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang byed ma ni lcags kyu dang zhags pa'o/ /gsod byed ma ni ral gri dang dus kyi zhags pa'o/ /phyogs kyi lha mo grwa bzhir 'khod pa ni/ sangs rgyas rin chen chos dang ni/ /rdo rje sgrol ma bsam bya ba/ /dkar dang ser po dmar po dang*/ /dkar min phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/ mchog stsol ba dang utpa la/ cang te de bzhin rtse gsum bsnams/ /zhal drug phyag drug tho ba dang*/ /zhags pa bsnams pa zhabs drug pa/ /tshangs pa 'joms pa gshin rje gshed/ /ral gri thod pas lag brel ba/ /mig yon dbang po dbang ldan gnon/ /dbyug to dang ni padma dang*/ /'khor lo zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchogakhro bo'i rgyal po pad mthar byed/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /klu dang gshin rje zhabs kyis mnan/

'khyil ba rdo rje phur bu ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje tho bar bcas/ /dril bu phur bu bsnams nas ni/ /log 'dren bdud bcas la 'debs brtson/ /dpa' bo 'di gsum sprin gyi mdog/ gzhan rnams gang rnams pho nya mo/ /rang rang las dang mtshungs par bya/ /gsang ba thams cad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyis bstod pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba gang*/ /rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de/ /ye shes mtshon cha rnam 'chang ba/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs spyod pa po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sngags can ma/ /dbang po'i dra ba 'od zer 'phro zhing 'khrug /lhan cig skyes pa'i mdzes ma dang gtsugs mdzad/ /blo gros chen pos bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /ces gsol ba btab par gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid kyi sku la yongs su zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems rnam par dbab pa rdo rje nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bas/ sems can thams cad mchog tu ྄bde ba grub par gyur to/ /rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /hūṃ gi yi ges bdud rnams gzhom/ /oṃ āḥ.ā li kā li ste/ rtsa gnyis zla ba nyi ma dag /de dag me long ye shes te/ /sa bon mtshan mar gyur pa ni/ so sor rtog par ngas bshad do/ /gcig gyur mnyam pa nyid yin te/ /'gro don byed pa bya nan tan/ / gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa chos dbyings so/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor rdo rje gsum/ /rab rdzogs sngags rnams kun gyi lha/ /gsang dang gsang chen shin tu gsang*/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ /rjes dang shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ /stong pa'i ye shes rnam gsum po/ /rgyud kun gyi ni gtso bo'i gtso/ /mi shigs pa dang sngags dang rdzas/ /thig le gsum du ngas bshad do/ /byin gyis rlabs dang yongs brtags dang*/ /yongs su rdzogs pa rnal 'byor gsum/ /mi gsal ba dang ye shes chung*/

/ye shes ye shes chen po ste/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ /gzugs med tshor ba 'du shes dang*/ /'du byed dang ni rnam shes bral/ /dbang po yul dang rnam shes med/ /nyon mongs med cing byang chub med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa med/ /'phel pa med cing bri ba med/ /rtag min mi rtag ma yin pa/ /yod dang med dang yod med 'das/ /'di la bdag med gzhan yang med/ /bden min rdzun pa ma yin pa/ /rkyen gyis stong min rang bzhin nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par brjod/ /dmigs dang dmigs med las 'das nas/ /bya ba ci dgar spyod byed pa/ /rig sngags grub pa gang yin pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod la gnas/ /sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa dang*/ /sgyu mas sgyu ma mchod byed ltar/ /thabs mkhas spyod pa 'di dag gis/ /rmi lam bzhin du sngags spyod pa'o/ /ji ltar me yis bsregs pa ltar/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bud med las/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa bskyed/ /g.yo ba thim dang bde ba dang*/ /rnam rtog ngo bo nyid kyi gcod/ /de phyir de la de rab bsgrub/ /mtha' med dbus kyang med rig pa/ /don dam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rtog pas rtog pa rnam spangs te/ /de phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'od gsal mchog tu nyer 'gro ba/ / bde dang sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ /rnam par mi rtog rnam par sbyangs/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa bcu gnyis/ /pho nya mo sbyor de nyid dang*/ /rtsa dang khams dang g.yo ba yi/ /'gro 'ong 'gags pa'i ye shes so/ /de nas de la ye shes sku/ / 'di la rtsa med khams kyang med/ /rlung gi bgrod pa'ang yod ma yin/ /'on kyang sems kyi rnam 'phrul te/ /de de 'gags las sa bcu gnyis/ /pho nya mo rnams sbyor grub las/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis bde ba 'di/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyis zhes brjod/ /las dang po dang rnal 'byor pa dang sgrub pa po/

/grub pa mchog tu grub pa dang ni sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya sngags brjod bdun du gsungs/ /bla ma'i drin gyis skye ba gcig rdzogs mngon gyur pa'o/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /zag med sems 'di de bzhin nyid/ /nam mkha' snod kyis dbye ba ltar/ /gnas skabs bdun du 'jig rten rtog /rdo rje rang bzhin 'gyur med pa/ /gnas skabs theg pa thug med kyis/ /de ni mi 'jigs g.yo ba med/ /nam mkha' lta bu gos pa med/ /ji ltar rab rib can dag gis/ /nam mkha' la ni skra shad mthong*/ /de bzhin 'khor ba rnam par rtog/'khor ba med cing gang zag med/ /de phyir bcos ma kun spangs nas/ /zung 'jug rang bzhin bsgom bya ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung lam la/ /sngags rig rnam rtog ma byed cig/rnal 'byor dbang pos skye bo ni/ /gang la'ang brnyas par mi bya ste/ /nyan thos nang du mi gnas shing*/ /chags bral lam la blo mi gus/ /bud med rin chen spang mi bya/ /nyan thos spyod pa spangs byas nas/ /'dod chags chen po snying rjer bcas/ /'dul ba'i thabs tshul kun rig pas/ /gnyis sbyor brtul zhugs la gnas pa'o/ /sdom dang sdom min kun las log/bza' dang bza' min mi brtag ste/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang dpyad mi bya/ /rang bzhin de nyid mnyam par shes/ /mgo zlum brtul zhugs gzi brjid can/ /mnyam nyid dmigs su med pa la/ /sdig dang bsod nams kun yod min/ /kun kyang byang chub spyod pa can/ /bud med sbyor las sems brtan pa/ /tshangs spyod ma nyams dge slong ste/ /dbang phyug kun gyi bla mar 'gyur/ /rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i ye shes kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ /rtog pa phyi ma gsang ba nges par bstan pa ji snyed pa rdzogs te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rtog pa ji snyed pa rdzogs

so/ /rgya gar lho phyogs rasmī shwa ra'i ljongs su sku 'khrungs pa rdo rje theg pa la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rje btsun buddha gupta la/ rgyud 'di zhib mor nyan cing bsgyur bar sla ba rnams tho re long ngai ba bsgyur zhing*/ dka' gnas rnams la reg zig gi rim pa mang du byas nas brtag dpyad mang du bgyis pa las/ slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po nirbā ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang*/ yang slad kyi paṇḍi ta purṇa badzra'i spyan sngar/ 'grel pa so so dang zhib tu sbyar te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o/ /zhus dag/ bkra shis//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ - PAGE 240 -- PAGE 271 -- PAGE 239 -
